Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: activities and molecule_dictionary. Join: activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Filter: assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217643'), standard_value IS NOT NULL, standard_relation IS NOT NULL, standard_relation = '='. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, molecule_chembl_id ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC.
